The text runs: The High Septon once told me that as we sin, so do we suffer. If that’s true, Lord Eddard, tell me ... why is it always the innocents who suffer most, when you high lords play your game of thrones? The break before why is an ELLIPSIS, not a comma, and the ellipsis is Martin's own, printed in the book, not an editorial cut. The note as drafted therefore misdescribes the very thing it exists to disclose, and a reader checking it against the page would catch the app out. Replace it with something that says the clause follows Varys's printed ellipsis after tell me, and that its first letter is raised.
